name: Poly Wavetable
description: This algorithm is inspired by the original Poly Wavetable algorithm on the disting EX. It is a complete polyphonic synthesizer, using wavetable oscillators. Each voice has two envelopes, a filter and an LFO.
gui_description: The display shows the notes being played by the various voices, each superimposed on a bar to indicate the note envelope. The waveform within the wavetable of the most recently played note is also shown.
